calls.title: Growthbook <> Robinhood - Demo/Trial Scoping
calls.summary: GrowthBook is presented as a complementary experimentation and feature flagging platform aimed at improving data analytics depth and speed while integrating with existing internal systems. It supports self-hosting for enhanced data privacy and connects with major data sources like Snowflake and BigQuery. The platform allows for flexible metric management with official and unofficial metrics, enabling detailed analysis without SQL. It optimizes large data queries and runs daily scorecards, showing significant cost reductions. Migration strategies were discussed, emphasizing phased approaches to maintain legacy experiments. Advanced testing features include multi-armed bandits and offline evaluations, with a collaborative development model that actively incorporates customer feedback during deployment.
calls.keywords: experiment platform, Bayesian testing, feature flags, metric slicing, warehouse-native, migration strategy

calls.title: GrowthBook <> Robinhood - POC Sync
calls.summary:
# GrowthBook <> Robinhood - POC Sync
Date: 2026-11-18 | Duration: 34m

## Summary
The discussion focused on evaluating GrowthBook as a possible enterprise alternative to Robinhood’s internal experimentation tool. The trial will use a self-hosted deployment, a new account, real production data sets, selected experiments, custom queries, and ad hoc slicing and dicing to assess workflow fit, performance, integrations, feature gaps, and operational usability. Henry’s experimentation team and selected data science stakeholders are expected to participate, with an initial group of about 20–25 people, supported through a private Slack channel and biweekly check-ins. Henry will document table-stakes use cases and success criteria, while Dan will prepare pricing, complete legal and security materials, and coordinate the trial channel. Activation is targeted for early the following week, subject to legal approval and environment readiness, with an early-December kickoff considered. The January 17 expiration remains in place, although holidays and procurement could reduce evaluation time. Broader adoption requires team alignment and demonstrated differentiation, while production experimentation is not expected before the earliest Q2 next year.

## Keywords
Experimentation platform, GrowthBook Enterprise, Proof of concept, Self-hosted deployment, Product experimentation, Procurement and security

## Action Items
**Dan Wathne**
Review Robinhood due-diligence and security questionnaires (07:19)
Obtain legal approval for trial documents and agreements (13:49)
Prepare commercial pricing (16:29)
Create private Slack channel (20:03)
Return security questionnaires and PSE agreement (20:03)
Provide trial licence key (20:51)
Coordinate kickoff timing (22:10)

**Henry Jewkes**
Define proof-of-concept success criteria (14:28)
Send technical questions (17:24)
Create new GrowthBook account (20:51)
Set up trial infrastructure and Okta access (21:31)
